hook: Most of us learned about money the hard way. In many wealthy families, kids learn it at the kitchen table, years before their first paycheck. In this video I go through 25 money lessons rich parents teach their kids, from three angles: the basic math of money, the attitudes that get passed down, and the practical playbook, from a teen Roth IRA to spotting scams. They work for adults too.
